Re-review complete and written to `.sdlc/runs/20261106-152445-feature-new-pages/review.json` (`verdict: "approved"`, 0 findings).

### Passing Checks
- **`packages/excalidraw/data/blob.ts`**: Skips `getScrollToContentState` only when `Array.isArray(data.appState?.pages) && data.appState.pages.length > 1`, preserving single-page and legacy scroll-to-content behavior while retaining multi-page viewports.
- **`packages/element/src/Scene.ts`**: `setActivePageId` updates `this.sceneNonce = ((this.sceneNonce ?? 0) + 1) | 0` only on an actual page switch (`pageId !== this.activePageId`), guaranteeing a distinct value from the immediately cached 1-entry renderer memo without drawing from `randomInteger()`.
- **`packages/excalidraw/tests/pages.test.tsx` & `packages/excalidraw/scene/export.ts`**: All round-1 findings fixed and the three new AC-2/AC-7 tests pass (`152/152` test files, `2649` passed, typecheck and lint exit 0).
- **Reverted unplanned edits**: `ConvertElementTypePopup.tsx`, `arrows/helpers.ts`, `App.selectionTool.ts`, and `App.wrap.ts` match `HEAD`.
